en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town in a hilly rural landscape. In the middle distance stands a church with a tall tower and bulbous spire, surrounded by clustered village houses. In the right foreground are several large villas on a sloping meadow, one with a turret and balcony. Rolling fields and a wooded hill, the Geisingberg, rise in the background. Red printed German text at the top identifies the scene.
